name: Adversarial MD evidence referee
task: Adjudicate the four MD reviews against the source and independent audit. Explicitly reject unsupported mechanisms, false contact distances, blanket PBC edits, unproven RNG reset and harmful charge/constraint edits. Preserve source microstate uncertainty, initial DITY geometry concerns and useful controls without arbitrary physical thresholds. Recommend the smallest defensible next study, emphasizing geometry/chemical/source validation before longer runs. Do not reassert a reviewer claim just because several same-model reviewers agree.

name: Dityrosine parameter and local-context referee
task: Audit DITY translation coverage, charge/atom graph and full-context construction; distinguish penalty annotations from actual errors. Prioritize a torsion/geometry validation with explicit reference and stop criteria.

name: MD sampling and statistical inference referee
task: Audit replica independence, precision adjustment, marker analysis and interpretation. Seek additional implementation concerns, not only acknowledged sampling limits. Rank minimally informative additional simulations and convergence diagnostics.

name: Dynamics protocol and numerical validation referee
task: Audit physical-system/constraint/platform checks, periodic imaging, restart state, controls, precision and acceptance gates. State precisely what numerical checks do and do not establish.

name: Connectivity versus rigidity transition referee
task: Audit actual network mechanisms and define a decisive finite-size/constraint/background-limit experiment. Distinguish a connected giant component, rigid backbone, nonzero modulus from embedding, and strain-driven crossover.

name: Spatial clustering and preferential-attachment referee
task: Design identifiable spatial topology interventions separating edge count, triangles, degree heterogeneity and hub-biased growth. State feasibility constraints and null models. Audit whether current dose actually changes adjacency.

name: Adaptive phase-boundary experiment designer
task: Specify candidate mechanism models, independent graph replicate unit, finite-size and seed design, metrics, uncertainty, held-out validation and compute-aware acquisition. Give a concrete first-stage run matrix and stopping rule; avoid arbitrary universal thresholds.

name: Adversarial network regime and workflow referee
task: Adjudicate the four topology/design reviews and the independent line-cycle audit. Check the exact line-count/expected-z algebra, the zero-bond tether counterexample and dose confounding. Correct false universal thresholds, claims that mean fibre length necessarily scales with W, and generic graph-rigidity shortcuts. Give a practical staged experimental matrix, expected-information-gain controller and independent held-out validation; distinguish the completed review from a future closed-loop simulator/AlphaEvolve service. Quantify what can and cannot be learned from connectivity, clustering and hub bias.
